# ECO Integrated Technologies

> ECO Integrated Technologies (ECO ITI) delivers chemical-free, sustainable cleantech solutions for water recovery and waste-to-energy conversion. Serving commercial, industrial, and oil & gas sectors with proprietary technologies that eliminate environmental harm while reducing costs.

## About

ECO Integrated Technologies is a cleantech company focused on sustainable environmental solutions. ECO ITI's technology portfolio addresses two critical industrial challenges: water recovery from waste streams and waste-to-energy conversion. All ECO ITI solutions are chemical-free and designed for commercial, industrial, and oil & gas applications.

## Technologies

### Regenion
Regenion is ECO ITI's proprietary waste-to-energy technology. It converts organic waste streams into usable energy without chemical inputs, reducing landfill dependency and generating value from materials previously considered waste.

### Water Recovery Systems
ECO ITI's water recovery systems extract clean, reusable water from industrial wastewater and produced water streams. Chemical-free process. Designed for oil & gas, manufacturing, and municipal applications.

## Industries Served

- Oil & Gas (produced water, fracking wastewater)
- Commercial and industrial facilities
- Municipal water treatment
- Agriculture
- Food and beverage manufacturing

- Approach: Chemical-free, sustainable cleantech
- Technologies: Regenion (waste-to-energy), Water Recovery Systems
